name: Orlivane Celtic Knot Birthstone Necklace for Women, Heart Pendant
highlights: Copper Pendant, Stainless Steel Chain 45 cm + 5 cm Extender, Cubic Zirconia, 12 Month Colors, Gift for Her
bullets: CELTIC TRINITY KNOT WITH A HEART — The pendant wraps a heart-shaped birthstone-color stone inside a Celtic trinity knot, outlined with a ring of small clear cubic zirconia.
12 BIRTHSTONE COLORS — Choose the color for each month, January to December. The center stones are AAA cubic zirconia in birthstone colors, not natural gemstones.
SIZE AND WEIGHT — The pendant measures 33.5 x 25.4 mm (1.32 x 1.0 in) with a 6 mm heart stone. The whole necklace weighs about 11.3 g.
ADJUSTABLE CHAIN — Stainless steel chain, 45 cm (17.7 in) plus a 5 cm (2 in) extender, so it can sit at the collarbone or a little lower.
GIFT FOR HER — A thoughtful birthday, anniversary or Mother's Day gift for a wife, mother, daughter or friend. Copper pendant with a silver-tone plated finish and dark accent lines.
desc: This Orlivane necklace pairs the Celtic trinity knot with a heart-shaped center stone in your birthstone color. The pendant is copper with a silver-tone plated finish and darkened knot lines, set with a ring of small clear cubic zirconia around the heart. It measures 33.5 x 25.4 mm and hangs from a stainless steel chain, 45 cm long with a 5 cm extender. Available in 12 month colors. Care: keep away from water, perfume and chemicals, and store dry.
